why: issue 2081 (2026-10-26) -- `rclc_executor_add_service_raw` whose callback also receives the request's `rmw_request_id_t` (writer GUID + client sequence number), as reported by the backend's `take_request_with_info` slot (zenoh, Cyclone DDS, XRCE-DDS; all zero when a backend reports none). It is the CDR-byte counterpart of rclc's `rclc_executor_add_service_with_request_id`, which nano-ros offers under rclc's own name and callback type since issue 2089 (2026-10-27): that one deserialises into caller-owned structs with the service descriptor's codecs; this one hands the callback CDR bytes and lets it decide whether a reply is sent. Same arena entry, removal path (`rclc_executor_remove_service`) and return codes as `rclc_executor_add_service_raw`. Held by `service_request_id.c` in `just check c`.
